crossRefs.note: These in the same way are those who are sown on the rocky places, who, when they have heard the word, immediately…
They have no root in themselves, but are short-lived. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word…
for Herod feared John, knowing that he was a righteous and holy man, and kept him safe. When he heard him, he did many…
He was the burning and shining lamp, and you were willing to rejoice for a while in his light.

translations.web: Behold, you are to them as a very lovely song of one who has a pleasant voice, and can play well on an instrument; for they hear your words, but they don’t do them.
translations.bsb: Indeed, you are to them like a singer of love songs with a beautiful voice, who skillfully plays an instrument. They hear your words but do not put them into practice.
